qs.q: During a routine cranial nerve examination, a patient is asked to clench their teeth while the examiner palpates the masseter muscles. Which nerve is being tested?
o: Lingual division of the hypoglossal nerve
Temporal motor branch of the facial nerve
Mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve
Motor component of the glossopharyngeal nerve
Sternocleidomastoid branch of the accessory nerve
qs.e: The mandibular division of CN V innervates the muscles of mastication like the masseter.
